title: Cards
summary: A flexible card component displaying media, title, description, and actions with three appearance variants.
features: Three appearance variants (plain, outline, haptic) for visual hierarchy
Customizable aspect ratios for media content
Support for inline links and call-to-action buttons
Two size options with responsive mobile padding
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Card component serves as the foundational building block for presenting content in easily digestible units within grid layouts. It enables website visitors to browse multiple content options efficiently, supporting quick comparison and easy access to information of interest.

## Use Cases

- Display product information, blog posts, or category previews in a structured format
- Present content with images, alt text, titles, descriptions, and call-to-action elements
- Create consistent card dimensions across grids to maintain visual harmony
- Support various content types through flexible media aspect ratios

## Design Rationale

The component offers three distinct appearance variants to accommodate different visual contexts and content hierarchies. The plain variant provides minimal styling, outline adds subtle borders for definition, and haptic introduces elevated visual feedback. This flexibility ensures cards integrate seamlessly into diverse page layouts while maintaining a consistent user experience.
